settings.label: CORS
settings.description: Lets browser apps on other origins call this service.

fields.name: allowCredentials
fields.label: Allow credentials
fields.description: Allows cookies and authorization headers on cross-origin requests.

fields.name: maxAge
fields.label: Preflight cache (seconds)
fields.description: How long browsers may cache a preflight response. -1 leaves it to the browser.

settings.label: Payload Validation
settings.description: Checks request payloads against their declared constraints before a resource runs.

settings.label: Treat Nilable as Optional
settings.description: Accepts a request that leaves out a nilable query parameter or header, instead of rejecting it.

settings.label: Lax Data Binding
settings.description: Binds payloads leniently: nil values become absent optional fields, and absent fields become nil.

settings.label: Media Type Prefix
settings.description: A prefix added to the subtype of every response media type, such as application/vnd.example+json.
